parsed.why: State-run facility restriction is a universal exposure, plus worst-tier hostile legislation, surgical birth-certificate bar and no state protections or hate-crime coverage; visitor documents mostly unaffected, so only modestly below parent 0.35.

Unique criminalisation reaching private businesses — restaurants, gas stations, venues, hospitals — misdemeanour up to a year, in force July 2026. Universal visitor-facing tier-1 exposure with criminal penalty, deeper than parent 0.35.

Birth-sex facility rule in government buildings with a public reporting form inviting complaints — engineered discovery — plus flag ban and most-hostile legislative record; no public-accommodation protection, but private venues open.

Courts repeatedly enjoin hostile laws, facilities and care bans blocked, marker changes preserved; only division improving. Parent passport, entry and custody regimes still apply, capping gains above 0.35.

Facility law limited to schools and colleges with no enforcement mechanism; care/sports ban enjoined, marriage recognised, municipal ordinances exist. DMV narrowing is resident-facing; exposure roughly the parent's 0.35, slightly worse legislatively.
